mechanisms.description: P1: an order whose only operative content revokes, rescinds or cancels another order does one thing and does it on issue; its consequence belongs to the other order's lifecycle. P2: an order whose only operative content amends or modifies another order merges into the parent on issue; its text continues as part of the parent until the parent ends; the parent's lifecycle carries it. P1 dates a revoke-only order by its own date or the effective date it states.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The order's date; for a revoke-only order that states an effective date, that date (P1).

mechanisms.description: A later instrument whose held text names the member (by number, or by its date and subject) and revokes, rescinds or supersedes it as a whole ends it (COORDINATOR_RULINGS P3). A Public Land Order is taken as BLM's official table states it, with the gap that the PLO text is not held.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The revoking order's date, or the effective date it states.

mechanisms.description: COORDINATOR_RULINGS P7: a later order abolishes by name the one body that is the member's only subject (a committee or board the member created or continued); the member has nothing left to govern.

COORDINATOR_RULINGS P3, express class: EO 3027 revokes 'All Executive Orders heretofore issued for the establishment of Defensive Sea Areas'; a member is in the class when its own text establishes a defensive sea area and it predates EO 3027.

Section 1202 of the Tax Reform Act of 1976 rewrote 26 U.S.C. 6103 from January 1, 1977: no federal officer may disclose a return except as Title 26 authorizes, and the new section has no inspection upon order of the President. The statute names no executive order and describes no class of orders, so under COORDINATOR_RULINGS P3 (D-20261021-unnamed-instruments, option C) it does not end the members; 1977-01-01 is a disclosed earlier candidate end only.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: None for the lead; 1977-01-01 is recorded in the gaps as a candidate end.

mechanisms.description: The order states its own end: a period ('for and during six months ... and for no longer time'), a date to which something is deferred or continued, a named day or days, or a fiscal year or other stated period for which rates apply. It also covers an authorization granted only 'pending' a stated later act, when a held instrument performs that act and fixes its date (EO 7321).
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The stated last day; where the order lets an earlier event end it (a proviso or 'unless otherwise directed'), the interval from the order's date to that stated day.

procedure.description: Amend-only orders that restate the whole operative text of the parent ('amended so as to prescribe as follows', 'amended to read as follows', 'the following amendments are hereby made'), which later orders then cite as the regulation itself.

lead.basis: The order's own text presents it as an amendment of the parent order (EO 330B and EO 980: the Army punishment limits of 1901 'amended so as to prescribe as follows'; EO 3723: 'the following amendments ... are hereby made' to the Hot Springs hospital rules of 1892; EO 6885: the order of August 25, 1892 'is hereby amended to read as follows'). Replacing a whole table or the whole text is still an amendment of the parent (P2, coordinator adjudication), so the member merges into the parent on issue and the parent's lifecycle carries the restated text.

gaps: Disclosure: its text continues as part of the parent until the parent ends; the parent's lifecycle carries it.

Later orders cite the restated text by the amending order's own number or date: EO 1173 and EO 1333 amend 'the Executive order dated Nov. 25, 1908' (EO 980); EO 5429 amends paragraphs 'provided ... by Executive Order No. 3723'; the Wikisource notes to EO 2043 (Sept. 5, 1914) say it supersedes EO 980, 1173 and 1333, an editor's note, not words of EO 2043. Under P2 these act on the parent; they are disclosed, and they are why the engine flags EO 330B (amended by EO 980) and EO 980.
If the owner treats a whole-text restatement as a new standing regulation, these four leads become open pending the instrument that ended the restated regulation (for EO 980, EO 2043).
